scripts.build: remotion render UserScenarioTaskAssignment out/user-scenario-task-assignment.raw.mp4 --overwrite && ffmpeg -y -i out/user-scenario-task-assignment.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -an out/user-scenario-task-assignment.mp4 && rm out/user-scenario-task-assignment.raw.mp4
scripts.build:sites: remotion render SitesLifecycle out/sites-lifecycle.raw.mp4 --overwrite && ffmpeg -y -i out/sites-lifecycle.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -an out/sites-lifecycle.mp4 && rm out/sites-lifecycle.raw.mp4
scripts.build:sites:x: npm run build:sites && ffmpeg -y -i out/sites-lifecycle.mp4 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=channel_layout=stereo:sample_rate=44100 -shortest -vf scale=in_range=pc:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -level 4.0 -preset veryfast -crf 20 -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k out/sites-lifecycle-x-compatible.mp4
